summary: Highwater Ethanol LLC filed an 8-K on 2026-06-04 for Item 1.01 regarding a Tax Credit Purchase Agreement dated 2026-05-29 with an unnamed North Dakota bank. The agreement sold $14,307,388 of 2025 Section 45Z clean fuel production tax credits and granted a right of first refusal on up to $14M/year of 2026-2029 credits. The deal has no disclosed price per share, premium, or board recommendation. Although structured as a sale of tax credits, it is a routine asset sale under a material definitive agreement, not a special situation. No special-situation characteristics are present.
